description: This file defines data structures and methods related to reporting entries in the Ginkgo testing framework, including report entry values, visibility policies, and associated utility functions.

classes.name: ReportEntryValue
classes.description: Wraps a report entry's value, enabling safe encoding and decoding into reports and across networks.

classes.name: ReportEntry
classes.description: Represents a report entry with metadata such as visibility, location, timestamp, and value.

classes.name: ReportEntryVisibility
classes.description: Enum governing the visibility of report entries in the Ginkgo console reporter.

classes.name: ColorableStringer
classes.description: Interface for report entry values that can provide a colorable string representation.

methods.name: WrapEntryValue
methods.description: Creates a new ReportEntryValue wrapping a given value.

methods.name: GetRawValue
methods.description: Returns the raw value contained within a ReportEntryValue.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ReportEntryValue, considering colorable and stringer interfaces.

methods.name: MarshalJSON
methods.description: Encodes a ReportEntryValue into JSON, capturing its representation.

methods.name: UnmarshalJSON
methods.description: Decodes JSON data into a ReportEntryValue, reconstructing the raw value.

methods.name: GobEncode
methods.description: Encodes ReportEntryValue into bytes for gob encoding.

methods.name: GobDecode
methods.description: Decodes bytes into a ReportEntryValue from gob encoding.

methods.name: StringRepresentation
methods.description: Returns the string representation of a ReportEntry.

methods.name: GetRawValue
methods.description: Returns the raw value from a ReportEntry.

methods.name: GetTimelineLocation
methods.description: Returns the timeline location of a ReportEntry.

methods.name: HasVisibility
methods.description: Checks if any report entries have specified visibility.

methods.name: WithVisibility
methods.description: Filters report entries by specified visibility.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the string form of ReportEntryVisibility.

methods.name: Is
methods.description: Checks if a visibility matches any of the provided visibilities.
